title: Fantastic Church to visit absolutely.
text:
Fantastic church on the street of the same name.
Saint Louis and Blanche of Castile share the same royal lineage, and with nobles from Normandy (Perche).
San Luis is an alternative street within the old town, very close to the Plaza de la Alameda.
San Luis de los Franceses is part of the church complex that borders the same street: La Macarena, San Luis de los Franceses, Santa Marina, San Marco, Santa Isabel etc
author: V867WEyannl

title: Great looking church
text:
Iglesia De San Luis De Los Franceses ( Church Of Saint Louis Of France  ) was a wonderful looking church my twin brother and I chanced upon as we were pub hopping around the wonderful Barrio De Macarena and what a great find. 
This church was constructed between 1699-1731 and built from designs from architect  Leonardo De  Figueroa ,a wonderful example of Baroque style architecture, interior is awesome, so many beautiful features to behold, externally it's a stunning building, very photogenic, if you're walking down Calle San Luis it's most definitely well worth checking out.
author: NeilKelly77

title: Jewel of the Spanish Baroque
text: Very rich array of frescoes, for one of the most typical buildings of Spanish Baroque. There is an entrance fee, but it's worth it!
author: fabios76

title: An immersive experience
text: Wonderful visit to the church of St. Louis of the French. Both the warmth in the voice, the narrative of what he tells you, and all the knowledge and anecdotes he narrates during the visit, have made this guide a very special moment in which you immerse yourself in another era. Isabel has undoubtedly become my go-to guide. I will repeat with her again without a doubt!
author: Mariajbolmar
